page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with the running head and page number at the top; the catchword and signature at the foot. No marginal notes.
page.running_head: LIBER II. Superstitiones & idola exemplis vel titulo Ecclesiæ frustra defendi.

main_text.head: Exercitatio XVII.
Laudatio facti Ebedmelechi, liberantis Ieremiam ex foveâ. Ier. 38.
main_text.p: Narretur breviter periculum Ieremię[?]: & liberatio per Ebedmelech.
Cōfirmatio seu laudatio ab honesto: quia multæ virtutes in eo concurrant.
I. Fiducia in Deum: quia fretus Dei auxilio suscepit rem humanitus impossibilem.
Probetur impossibilitas à maiori. Rex non poterat cohibere principes, &c. Fiducia Ebedmelechi, testimonio ipsius Dei. cap.39.18.
Amplificetur ab ejus persona: quod Æthiops.
II. Pietas in Prophetam, cujus calamitate afficitur.
III. Fortitudo: quia suscipit patrocinium Prophetæ odiosum & periculosum.
IV. Magnanimitas: quia libere: publicè: & constanter.
Ostendatur ex circumstantiis: ubi & quomodo causam egerit.
VI. Prudentia, quod arripit vetustos pannos, ut an-

page.notes: The leading mark before "Amplificetur" (the second paragraph of the "Amplificetur" items) is a pointing-hand or sign symbol; it could not be reproduced and is omitted. "Ieremię" is doubtful: the final letter looks like ç or ę. The bar over the o in "Cōfirmatio" is faint. Catchword "ut an-" sits at the right below the last line.
